name: SiAP-BPK
tagline: Integral System for Audit Preparation. Ready Data, Ready Audit, Ready Opinion.

data.title: Transform Audit Panic into Measurable Readiness
data.description: Leave behind outdated methods relying on scattered documents and manual checklists. SiAP-BPK consolidates data, automates reminders, and ensures your institution's audit readiness score consistently exceeds 90% before the auditors arrive.

features.title: Readiness Dashboard & Vulnerability Mapping
features.desc: Full visibility for executives with color-coded indicators per department. Identify vulnerable areas (e.g., Infrastructure or Health) before they turn into actual audit findings.

features.title: Structured Repository & Dynamic Checklist
features.desc: Documents are secured in standardized folders per Fiscal Year, equipped with smart checklists that adapt based on the history of past audit findings.

features.title: Early Warning System (WhatsApp)
features.desc: Prevents last-minute task accumulation. The system automatically monitors document status and sends alerts via WhatsApp to the person in charge starting 30 days prior.

features.title: LHP Follow-up Module
features.desc: Closes compliance gaps post-audit. Track the completion status of auditor recommendations in real-time, from 'Not Yet Followed Up' to fully resolved.

data.title: Why Choose SiAP-BPK?
data.subtitle: Readiness is Not a Coincidence, It is a System

items.title: One-Click Data Provision
items.desc: Cuts down physical document retrieval time from days to less than a day. All archives are digitized and neatly indexed.

items.title: Prevent Digital Amnesia
items.desc: Employee rotation is no longer a liability. Institutional memory and past audit histories are permanently stored as a guiding framework.

items.title: Real-time Executive Visibility
items.desc: Department Heads can monitor audit readiness directly from their screens without having to hold time-consuming weekly evaluation meetings.

items.title: Eliminate Cognitive Overload for Staff
items.desc: Field staff and treasurers no longer need to panic over memorizing complex checklists, as all deadlines and schedules are fully managed by the system.

items.q: How do you prevent staff from uploading random documents just to get a 'Green' status?
items.a: The system features Multi-Layered Internal Verification. An indicator will not turn green simply by uploading a file; it requires an absolute approval from the direct supervisor or the Department Secretary.

items.q: Are the institution's financial documents secure within this system?
items.a: Highly secure. The system can be hosted On-Premise on the government's intranet or via an encrypted Cloud. Access rights are strictly limited using Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

items.q: Does this application integrate directly (via API) with BPK or SIPD?
items.a: No. SiAP-BPK is designed as a standalone system to secure internal agency data. However, it provides CSV/Excel import capabilities to migrate indicator data massively and quickly.
